title: Understanding Bluff and Fold in Texas Hold'em
summaryJa: テキサスホールデムの「ブラフ」と「フォールド」は、ポーカーで最も基本的な戦略です。ブラフは弱いハンドで強いふりをすることで、フォールドは手を降りることです。この二つの動きはゲームの中核となる駆け引きを作ります。
segments: Texas Hold'em has many important words. Two of the most common words are "bluff" and "fold.
" Learning these words helps you understand poker better. Let me explain what they mean.
A bluff is when you bet or raise money even though you have a bad hand. You want other players to think your hand is good.
If they believe you, they will fold their cards. Then you win the pot without showing your cards.
For example, you have a 2 and a 7. These are very bad cards.
But you bet a lot of money. Other players think you have good cards.
Fold means you quit the hand. You throw your cards away.
You do not put any more money in the pot. Players fold when they think they cannot win.
For example, you have a Queen and a Jack. Another player bets a lot of money.
You think their hand is better than yours. You decide to fold.
You lose the money you already gave to the pot. But you do not lose any more money.
Good poker players use bluff and fold together. Sometimes they bluff.
Sometimes they fold. Other players do not know what they will do next.
This is smart poker. You must practice these moves many times to play well.
